headline: Interim government led by Muhammad Yunus took oath on August 8, 2024, students on streets
summary: The formation of the interim government marked a new political chapter in Bangladesh. Meanwhile, students continued their civic duties, voluntarily managing traffic, cleaning, and ensuring security on the streets.
details: On August 8, 2024, an interim government led by Professor Muhammad Yunus was sworn in, initiating a new chapter in Bangladesh's political landscape. This significant development followed a period of widespread public unrest and demands for change.

Despite the government transition, students remained actively engaged on the streets, taking on various civic responsibilities. They voluntarily managed traffic, participated in clean-up efforts, and contributed to maintaining security across different areas.
caption:
August 8, 2024: A day of significant political transition in Bangladesh as an interim government took power. Students continued their pivotal role on the streets, managing civic duties.

On August 8, 2024, an interim government led by Professor Muhammad Yunus was sworn in, initiating a new chapter in Bangladesh's political landscape. This significant development followed a period of widespread public unrest and demands for change.

Despite the government transition, students remained actively engaged on the streets, taking on various civic responsibilities. They voluntarily managed traffic, participated in clean-up efforts, and contributed to maintaining security across different areas.

#Bangladesh #Politics #InterimGovernment #StudentMovement #MuhammadYunus #News

Source: Prothom Alo
